fixed: "Neighbor Roll Away" and "Partner roll away" now come in as a roll away with your neighbor or partner, instead of one where the neighbors roll each other away. "Neighbor rollaway w/ half sashay", as Caller's Companion writes it, now comes in as a roll away too. This applies to imports and to figures you type.
An imported 8-beat box circulate now includes its balance; a 4-beat one has none.

changed: The shared figure recognizer reads a lone relationship before "roll away" as roll_away's whom, leaving who to the default with assumedSubject; it also reads "rollaway" and "w/ half sashay".
parseFigureLine sets box_circulate's balance: true when the line has 8 beats.
The CallersBox per-role roll-away annotation fills who on the whom reading and clears assumedSubject.
